She enjoys a good fight as much as she enjoys a glass of sake. She is often seen laughing out loud, celebrating victories, or simply having fun with friends and allies.

Freedom-loving: As an oni, Yuugi values freedom above all else. She does not tolerate restrictions or orders that she considers unfair, and makes a point of living life according to her own rules.
